title: ToastQueue keeps the footer `note` and the `showing`/`waiting` toasts as two copies of one note, reconciled by hand in advance()
trigger: set_note_in stores the note in `note` and pushes it into `showing`/`waiting`; clear_note, drop_toasts and advance each reset one half to match the other
effect: none today; a new path that sets one half only would leave a footer note with no toast or a toast with no note
fix: one enum per note: Footer(note) | Toast{note,timer} so the toast stage owns the note

title: Order::Reordering(keys) waits for the model to echo a pinned-chat reorder but holds no request and has no timeout
trigger: drag a pin on the Touch Bar so Command::ReorderPinned is sent (driver returns Ok(Some)); TDLib then rejects the reorder asynchronously (offline, flood wait, chat unpinned elsewhere)
effect: dropped_order_holds keeps returning the local dropped order while the model has the same pins in another order (Echo::Waiting), so the Touch Bar shows an order the server does not have until the pin set itself changes; only a synchronous Err calls reorder_refused
fix: Reordering { request: RequestId } settled by the driver's answer (ok -> Model, error -> Model + reorder_refused)

title: Touch Bar viewer slider seeks on every continuous slider event, while the audio slider waits for `done`
trigger: drag the Touch Bar seek slider while a video is open in the media viewer
effect: a seek request per slider event (up to tens per second) instead of one on release; wasted decoder work and stutter
fix: ViewerSeek { fraction, done } like PlayerSeek, seek only on done

title: baseline: EditorStage::Reading/Encoding carry a `serial: u64` counter next to the Task that already cancels a replaced stage
trigger: open the video editor, or press Done; the answer is matched by `is_reading(serial)` / `is_encoding(serial)` through next_editor_serial()
effect: none today; the held Task is dropped when the stage changes, so the counter only guards a closure that cannot run any more
fix: drop the serial; the stage holding the Task is the identity (or hold a RequestId for the probe/encode job)

title: open_video_editor overwrites an open VideoEditorDialog without releasing its cover frame temp file
trigger: an editor is open with a cut cover (CoverFrame.path in the temp dir) and another open_video_editor call replaces send_box.video_editor (e.g. a tray item and a sticker editor opened in turn from different windows)
effect: the old CoverFrame png stays in quill-video-edits until the scratch sweep; only close_video_editor removes it
fix: replace through one close-then-open transition (take the old editor and delete its cover)

title: baseline: start_update_checks is a detached 4 h loop; download_update keeps a 250 ms redraw loop; spawn_open_poll polls every 50 ms
trigger: app start (update checks), a running update download, any VideoPlayer in Opening
effect: the 4 h loop is never cancelled and keeps asking while the app is locked or the account is logged out; the other two are held by their stage/player and end with it
fix: hold the re-check Task in UpdateState (Idle { next_check: Task }) and wake on the download progress signal instead of a 250 ms poll

title: ViewerUi::open_gen is a bare u64 bumped by hand at six sites and compared by PendingGallery.viewer_opens to tell which viewer open it asked for
trigger: press a profile photo (wait_for_profile_gallery stamps open_gen), open another viewer item or close it before the gallery lands
effect: none today; every new open path must remember `open_gen += 1` or a late gallery opens over the wrong viewer
fix: the viewer's open is one value (MediaViewer::Open{id}) and the pending gallery holds that id, or a RequestId for the gallery fetch

title: StoryOpen::Waiting holds the PendingStoryOpen but no RequestId or Task; resolve_pending_story_open polls story_fetch by (chat, story) from upkeep
trigger: press a story, a repost label or a story link while the story is not cached
effect: works today because get_story marks a failed send; the wait is matched by chat+story key, not by the getStory request, so a second press of the same story shares one answer
fix: Waiting { open, request: RequestId } settled by that request's answer or error

title: baseline: current() uses RefCell::borrow() on the thread-local CURRENT
trigger: scope() runs a build closure that re-enters current() while replace() is mid-call (not reachable today: replace is a single statement)
effect: a BorrowError panic would take the window down; no path found
fix: try_borrow with a None fallback, as the rest of the file does

title: A strip frame that failed to render (StripFrame::Failed) is kept as done; video_editor_reload_frames only recuts when the frame count or strip width changes
trigger: open the video editor on a clip where ffmpeg fails for one timestamp
effect: a blank cell in the timeline strip until the dialog is resized or reopened
fix: Failed cells keep their time and are asked again once, or the strip shows the last good frame

title: pump_translation retries Translation::Failed messages only when the chat is reopened (scan removed from the pump map)
trigger: translate a chat while offline or after a flood wait so some messages fail, then go back online with the chat still open
effect: the failed messages stay untranslated until the chat is closed and opened again
fix: a per-message Failed { at } that the pump retries after a backoff, instead of a reopen
